name: The Rent Notice
title: Eviction Declaration!
description: a notice on your door. the rent doubled. then tripled. the number keeps moving. your bank account is watching.
appearance: you see the notice. the number is wrong. the number is always wrong. but this time it's wrong in a way that has teeth.
thatMoment: the moment you realize the number on the notice is the same as your bank balance. exactly.

forgedEquipment.name: Eviction Order: Reversed
forgedEquipment.desc: the rent doesn't go up when you're around. landlords look at you and forget why they came. sometimes they leave money.
